notes.title: Update 1.0.6 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix ending sequence not working as intended. Endings should play properly from now on before rolling the credits.
[*]A new design was made for level 5-5.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed level 4-5 being having left out one point from the maximum score even though the level itself was completely solved.
[*]Repositioned merchant to his proper place in World 2 and 3 intermission levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 Note
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix music not playing in an intermission level when loading from a save file.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 Note
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Add a controls display toggle in the Options Menu
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] If there appears to be a single color used for buttons and levers, you will not be asked which color it will be and will use it with the respective color immediately.
[*] Fixed levels from 2-1 and onward playing the same music. They will play different tracks from now on.
[*] Fixed loading files saved in intermission levels resulting in the [i]previous[/i] level being loaded instead. [b]Any save files affected by this will not be fixed and should be overwritten by new ones.[/b]
[*] Reduced pause button cooldown when opening and closing the pause menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Note
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where interacting with a lever multiple times required a non-existing item.
[/list]
